description: CONCERNS 5 + 6 (shared CDK/deploy surface — designed together). (a) Fix deploy_all.py pre_deploy_cleanup() so orphaned-log-group deletion is GATED on the same failed/absent condition as the stack deletion — never delete a healthy (CREATE_COMPLETE/UPDATE_COMPLETE) stack's managed log groups; a healthy stack is left for an in-place CloudFormation UPDATE (same runtime ARNs, new version). (b) Add a conditional content-safety Bedrock Guardrail as an ADDITIONAL resource INSIDE the existing AgentCoreStack (NOT a new stack) in cdk-stack.ts, injecting BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID/VERSION into eligible runtimes via the existing payment env-injection pattern. (c) Wire BedrockModel to use the guardrail CONDITIONALLY via the shared constants.bedrock_model_kwargs() (unset env -> built exactly as today, so deploy works without guardrail-create permissions). (d) Document the env-var contract in .env.example and the read-only deploy confirmations. Depends on FEAT-002 (bedrock_model_kwargs already exists there) and FEAT-001.
steps: TEST FIRST (deploy cleanup): add tests/test_deploy_all.py. Refactor deploy_all.py so its top-level deploy flow runs under a main() guarded by `if __name__ == '__main__':` (it executes deploy at import today) — this is a prerequisite for importing it in a test. Extract the state-gating into a pure helper _should_cleanup(status) -> bool (True only for ROLLBACK_COMPLETE/ROLLBACK_FAILED/CREATE_FAILED/DELETE_FAILED or no stack). Test: healthy status (CREATE_COMPLETE/UPDATE_COMPLETE) -> _should_cleanup False and, with aws_cli mocked, pre_deploy_cleanup issues ZERO delete-log-group AND ZERO delete-stack calls; a FAILED status -> stack deleted AND orphan log groups deleted.

In src/agents/players/deploy_all.py: wrap the top-level script body in main() + the __main__ guard; move the /aws/lambda/TeamUnified-* log-group deletion loop INSIDE the failed/absent branch (use _should_cleanup) so it never runs when the stack is healthy. Keep the orphan-cleanup purpose for failed deploys.

TEST FIRST (CDK): extend src/agents/players/agentcore/cdk/test/cdk.test.ts (Jest) — with the createBedrockGuardrail flag SET (context or process.env.CREATE_BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL='true') the synthesized template contains an AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail resource and the five runtimes receive BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID/VERSION env vars; with the flag UNSET there is NO guardrail resource and NO guardrail env vars.

In src/agents/players/agentcore/cdk/lib/cdk-stack.ts: add `import * as bedrock from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-bedrock'`; read createGuardrail via this.node.tryGetContext('createBedrockGuardrail') OR process.env.CREATE_BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL==='true'; when set create CfnGuardrail (content filters HATE/INSULTS/SEXUAL/VIOLENCE/MISCONDUCT MEDIUM, prompt-attack INPUT HIGH, one off-domain/role-override denied topic, required name + blockedInputMessaging + blockedOutputsMessaging) + CfnGuardrailVersion; inject BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID/VERSION into runtimes reusing the isPaymentEligibleAgent guard + this.application.environments.values() + env.runtime.addEnvironmentVariable pattern; add CfnOutputs. CONFIRM the exact L1 class/attr/prop names (CfnGuardrail, CfnGuardrailVersion, attrGuardrailId, attrVersion, guardrailIdentifier) and the filter/topic property shapes against aws-cdk-lib ~2.261.0 BEFORE writing; record confirmations in findings. If the flag does NOT reach synthesis under `agentcore deploy` (verify read-only), take the committed-config fallback: thread the flag via bin/cdk.ts + an AgentCoreStackProps field (pull those into scope only then).

TEST FIRST (model kwargs guardrail): extend tests/test_constants.py — with BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID set, bedrock_model_kwargs() includes guardrail_id and guardrail_version; unset -> neither key present (env-patched, pure, no AWS).

Wire guardrail usage through the shared constants.bedrock_model_kwargs() (the env readers + helper exist from FEAT-002): ensure unified_agent.register() and planner._default_agent() both build BedrockModel(**constants.bedrock_model_kwargs()). Unset id -> model built exactly as today; a runtime guardrail block is already caught by invoke()'s existing fallback (no new hot-path handling).

Document the contract in .env.example only (DO NOT touch .env or the Makefile): CREATE_BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL=, BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID=, BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION=DRAFT, with a comment that blank = run without a guardrail. Record (in findings, not committed scratch) the read-only pre-redeploy health check `aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name AgentCore-TeamUnified-default --region us-east-1 --query "Stacks[0].StackStatus" --output text` (expect *_COMPLETE) and that `agentcore deploy` publishes a NEW VERSION of the same runtime ARN (discover the real list-versions verb via `aws bedrock-agentcore-control help`).
acceptance_criteria: pre_deploy_cleanup never deletes a healthy stack or its log groups and DOES clean up a FAILED stack + orphan log groups; `uv run pytest -q tests/test_deploy_all.py` passes.

The guardrail is a conditional ADDITIONAL resource inside AgentCoreStack (same stack), present only when the flag is set, with runtime env injection via the eligibility-guarded loop; `npm run build && npm test` in the cdk dir pass for both flag-set and flag-unset cases.

bedrock_model_kwargs() includes the guardrail only when BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID is set; unset = built as today so deploy works without guardrail-create permissions; `uv run pytest -q tests/test_constants.py` passes.
.env.example documents the three vars (blank default); .env and Makefile untouched.
verification: cd src/agents/players/agentcore/cdk && npm run build && npm test
findings:
DONE (with a MID-FEAT SCOPE CORRECTION). Suite 93 -> 108 passing via `uv run pytest -q`. SCOPE CHANGE from the parent: the ENTIRE vended CDK project under src/agents/players/agentcore/cdk/ (cdk-stack.ts, bin/cdk.ts, agentcore.json) is OFF-LIMITS — the design's assumption that cdk-stack.ts was ours to edit was RETRACTED. So the guardrail is NO LONGER a CDK CfnGuardrail resource and NO env-injection was added to cdk-stack.ts. VERIFIED zero edits under the cdk/ tree (`git status --short -- src/agents/players/agentcore/cdk` is empty); the untouched CDK project still builds+tests clean (`npm run build && npm test` -> 1 passed). npm install was run (creates gitignored node_modules only) and `tsc` wrote gitignored dist/ — neither is a source change.

(a) DEPLOY CLEANUP FIX (concern 6) — src/agents/players/deploy_all.py: refactored so the whole top-level deploy flow now lives under main() behind `if __name__=='__main__': main()` (it ran at import before — a prerequisite for importing it in a test). Signal-handler registration moved inside main() (no import side effects). Added pure helper `_should_cleanup(status)->bool` (True only for ROLLBACK_COMPLETE/ROLLBACK_FAILED/CREATE_FAILED/DELETE_FAILED or None/absent; False for CREATE_COMPLETE/UPDATE_COMPLETE/any transient). pre_deploy_cleanup() now EARLY-RETURNS when not _should_cleanup(status), so a HEALTHY stack gets ZERO delete-stack AND ZERO delete-log-group calls — the orphan log-group sweep moved INSIDE the failed/absent branch (was unconditional = the bug). NOTE load_dotenv() still runs at import (reads repo .env with os.environ.setdefault — import-safe, no network); the test imports+reloads deploy_all fine.

(b) OWN-CODE GUARDRAIL (concern 5, re-approached) — NEW src/agents/players/setup_guardrail.py (NEVER imported by the runtime). `build_guardrail_config()` is pure (no AWS/env) -> boto3 create_guardrail body: contentPolicyConfig.filtersConfig = HATE/INSULTS/SEXUAL/VIOLENCE/MISCONDUCT at inputStrength=outputStrength=MEDIUM + PROMPT_ATTACK inputStrength=HIGH/outputStrength=NONE (prompt-attack is input-only), topicPolicyConfig.topicsConfig = ONE DENY topic 'off-domain-or-role-override', plus required name + blockedInputMessaging + blockedOutputsMessaging. `ensure_guardrail(client=None, region=None)` is a NO-OP unless CREATE_BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL is truthy (1/true/yes/on); when enabled it calls injected-or-lazy boto3 bedrock client.create_guardrail(**config) then create_guardrail_version(guardrailIdentifier=id) and returns (guardrail_id, version); boto3 imported lazily so the module imports with no boto3. main() prints the id/version or notes it's disabled. deploy_all.main() now calls setup_guardrail.ensure_guardrail(region=region) BEFORE pre_deploy_cleanup and, when enabled, exports BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID/VERSION into os.environ.

(c) MODEL WIRING — already satisfied by FEAT-002 and UNCHANGED: constants.bedrock_model_kwargs() adds guardrail_id/guardrail_version ONLY when BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID is set; unified_agent._default_agent_factory and planner._default_agent both build BedrockModel(**constants.bedrock_model_kwargs()). Unset id => model built exactly as today, so deploy works without guardrail-create permissions. No new hot-path handling.

(d) DOCS — .env.example only (NOT .env, NOT Makefile): documented CREATE_BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL=, BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID=, BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION=DRAFT (all blank = run WITHOUT a guardrail) with the enablement recipe (`uv run python src/agents/players/setup_guardrail.py`).

CONFIRMED boto3 bedrock CreateGuardrail API (installed botocore): camelCase keys match the CFN names — name, description, blockedInputMessaging, blockedOutputsMessaging, contentPolicyConfig.filtersConfig[].{type,inputStrength,outputStrength}, topicPolicyConfig.topicsConfig[].{name,definition,type,examples}. type enum = SEXUAL/VIOLENCE/HATE/INSULTS/MISCONDUCT/PROMPT_ATTACK; strength enum = NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH; topic type enum = DENY only. Version verb = create_guardrail_version(guardrailIdentifier=...) -> {version}. (The aws-cdk-lib ~2.261.0 CfnGuardrail L1 WAS confirmed before the scope change — CfnGuardrail/CfnGuardrailVersion exist; props blockedInputMessaging, blockedOutputsMessaging, name, contentPolicyConfig.filtersConfig[].{type,inputStrength,outputStrength}, topicPolicyConfig.topicsConfig[].{name,definition,type}; attrs attrGuardrailId/attrGuardrailArn/attrVersion; CfnGuardrailVersion{guardrailIdentifier} -> attrVersion. Recorded for completeness; NOT used because cdk/ is off-limits.)

READ-ONLY DEPLOY CONFIRMATIONS (account 937592087229, us-east-1, WSParticipantRole): `aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name AgentCore-TeamUnified-default --query Stacks[0].StackStatus` => CREATE_COMPLETE (HEALTHY) — exactly the case the fix protects: the OLD code would have deleted this live stack's log groups; _should_cleanup('CREATE_COMPLETE') => False leaves it for an in-place UPDATE. The 5 runtimes exist via `aws bedrock-agentcore-control list-agent-runtimes` as TeamUnified_ai_{gk,def,mid,fwd1,fwd2}_agent (version 1). CONFIRMED the real version verbs on bedrock-agentcore-control: ListAgentRuntimeVersions (CLI list-agent-runtime-versions) and UpdateAgentRuntime (a redeploy publishes a NEW version of the SAME runtime ARN). No resources were created/modified — all AWS calls were read-only.

OPEN ITEM (carry forward): runtime env-var injection into the AgentCore runtimes flows ONLY through the vended cdk/ layer (env.runtime.addEnvironmentVariable + the gateway-URL Fn::GetAtt in the synthesized template's EnvironmentVariables block); .env is NOT staged into the agent CodeZip bundles by deploy_all (it stages commons/plugins/governance + SHARED_MODULES + requirements.txt only). Since cdk/ is untouchable, there is NO automatic path for BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID/VERSION to reach a deployed runtime's process environment without a cdk/ edit. Documented as a manual/env-provided step in .env.example. The guardrail attaches to BedrockModel only when the runtime sees BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID; a runtime-level guardrail block is already caught by invoke()'s existing fallback. TESTS: tests/test_deploy_all.py (9: _should_cleanup gating + healthy=zero-deletes + failed=stack+2 log-groups deleted), tests/test_setup_guardrail.py (6: pure config shape + gated-off no-op + enabled create+version). FEAT-002's tests/test_constants.py already covers bedrock_model_kwargs() guardrail set/unset (no new test needed there). NO regressions to tests/test_e2e_tick.py or the infinite-loop safety tests (full suite 108 green). NOT TOUCHED: src/governance/guardrails.md, Makefile, .env, ai-team-strands-balanced/, sample-ai-possibilities/, and the entire src/agents/players/agentcore/cdk/ tree.
